title: The Crane Taller Than the Barn
synopsis: Molly watches a towering crane lift steel sections for the assembly complex. A wind check pauses the lift, demonstrating patience.
continuity_state: Before: Foundation and trench work are completed to the engineers' satisfaction; the assembly complex and tower steel are beginning to rise. After: The assembly building and launch tower grow in safely staged pieces. Mr. Lee visits as an observer, not a rocket engineer.
